title: KuINins as a New Class of HIV-1 Inhibitors That Block Post-Integration DNA Repair.
authors: Anisenko, Andrey; Galkin, Simon; Mikhaylov, Andrey A; Khrenova, Maria G; Agapkina, Yulia; Korolev, Sergey; Garkul, Lidia; Shirokova, Vasilissa; Ikonnikova, Viktoria A; Korlyukov, Alexander; Dorovatovskii, Pavel; Baranov, Mikhail; Gottikh, Marina
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HIV-1整合酶与Ku70蛋白互作抑制剂，通过分子动力学建模其结合模式，虽属蛋白-DNA修复相关互作且用MD方法，但非TF-DNA体系，可借鉴其蛋白-核酸界面建模思路。
abstract: Integration of HIV-1 genomic cDNA results in the formation of single-strand breaks in cellular DNA, which must be repaired for efficient viral replication. Post-integration DNA repair mainly depends on the formation of the HIV-1 integrase complex with the Ku70 protein, which promotes DNA-PK assembly at sites of integration and its activation. Here, we have developed a first-class inhibitor of the integrase-Ku70 complex formation that inhibits HIV-1 replication in cell culture by acting at the stage of post-integration DNA repair. This inhibitor, named s17, does not affect the main cellular function of Ku70, namely its participation in the repair of double-strand DNA breaks through the non-homologous end-joining pathway. Using a molecular dynamics approach, we have constructed a model for the interaction of s17 with Ku70. According to this model, the interaction of two phenyl radicals of s17 with the L76 residue of Ku70 is important for this interaction. The requirement of two phenyl radicals in the structure of s17 for its inhibitory properties was confirmed using a set of s17 derivatives. We propose to stimulate compounds that inhibit post-integration repair by disrupting the integrase binding to Ku70 KuINins.
abstract_zh: HIV-1基因组cDNA的整合导致细胞DNA中产生单链断裂，这些断裂必须被修复以保证病毒的有效复制。整合后DNA修复主要依赖于HIV-1整合酶与Ku70蛋白复合物的形成，该复合物促进DNA-PK在整合位点的组装及其激活。在此，我们开发了一类一流的整合酶-Ku70复合物形成抑制剂，该抑制剂通过作用于整合后DNA修复阶段来抑制细胞培养中的HIV-1复制。这种名为s17的抑制剂不影响Ku70的主要细胞功能，即其通过非同源末端连接途径参与双链DNA断裂的修复。利用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 方法，我们构建了s17与Ku70相互作用的模型。根据该模型，s17的两个苯基与Ku70的L76残基的相互作用对此结合至关重要。通过一系列s17衍生物的实验，我们确认了s17结构中两个苯基对其抑制特性的必要性。我们建议促进那些通过破坏整合酶与Ku70结合来抑制整合后修复的化合物，即KuINins。
